output: 
  html_document:
    theme: united
---

<canvas id="game" width="320" height="480"></canvas>

```{js, echo=FALSE}
const cvs = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = cvs.getContext("2d");

let birdY = 150;
let gravity = 0.5;
let velocity = 0;
let pipeX = 320;
let pipeGap = 100;
let pipeHeight = 150;

window.addEventListener("keydown", () => velocity = -8);
cvs.addEventListener("mousedown", () => velocity = -8);

function draw() {
  velocity += gravity;
  birdY += velocity;
  pipeX -= 2;
  if (pipeX < -50) pipeX = 320;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#70c5ce";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 480);

  ctx.fillStyle = "yellow";
  ctx.fillRect(50, birdY, 20, 20);

  ctx.fillStyle = "green";
  ctx.fillRect(pipeX, 0, 50, pipeHeight);
  ctx.fillRect(pipeX, pipeHeight + pipeGap, 50, 480);

  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();
```
